content: Root cause: The inconsistency in the switch port labels across different board variants led to confusion and potential misconfiguration. The labels "gbe0" and "gbe1" were changed to "swp0" and "swp1" to ensure uniformity in naming conventions, allowing for easier identification and management of switch ports. This change was necessary to maintain consistency across the device tree source (DTS) files for the various board variants, as users should not have to deal with differing names for the same hardware functionality.
